definitions.explanation: A severe misfortune or disaster, often with connotations of fate or supernatural causes. More literary and dramatic than everyday words for disaster.

examples.japanese: {厄災|やくさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}りかかる→降りかかる：28386_furikakaru⟧。
{厄災|やくさい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To perform a purification ritual to protect oneself from calamity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{厄災|やくさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: War is one of the greatest calamities for humankind.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{厄災|やくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われて→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧きた。
examples.english: This region has been hit by calamity many times in the past.

notes:
A literary word for calamity or disaster, often carrying connotations of fate, divine punishment, or forces beyond human control. Commonly encountered in literature, historical writing, fantasy/game contexts, and formal speeches. In everyday conversation, ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧ or ⟦{災難|さいなん}→災難：04161_sainan⟧ are more typical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厄災|やくさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}りかかる→降りかかる：28386_furikakaru⟧: for calamity to befall
- {厄災|やくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧: to be struck by calamity
- {厄災|やくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらす→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧: to bring about disaster
- {厄災|やくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to ward off calamity
- {厄災|やくさい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧: to escape from disaster

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: disaster — the standard neutral term, used for natural disasters and emergencies
- ⟦{災難|さいなん}→災難：04161_sainan⟧: misfortune — personal-scale bad luck or trouble
- ⟦{惨事|さんじ}→惨事：28385_sanji⟧: tragedy, catastrophe — emphasizes the horrific nature of an event
- ⟦{天災|てんさい}→天災：29302_tensai⟧: natural disaster — specifically caused by nature
- ⟦{厄|やく}→厄：11989_yaku⟧: bad luck, unlucky year — relates to superstition about certain ages

FORMS:
⟦{厄|やく}→厄：11989_yaku⟧ (misfortune, bad luck) + {災|さい} (disaster) — combines two characters both relating to calamity.
